component: 双作品·世界书差异更新器 v1（学战两卷 20261109.1）

checks.name: packaged templates preserve second-volume keys and independent EJS scopes
205-entry raw book updates only eleven target contents and preserves every metadata field
MVU contents equal the maintained templates; lore keeps original EJS and one shared declaration
old wrappers upgrade to single templates; repeated updates are idempotent and malformed wrappers reject
missing or ambiguous comments fail; format alias selection never assumes UIDs
style replaces only the overbroad numeric ban and preserves examples and metadata
offline apply shares the plan, preserves inactive format and writes nothing on invalid input
import only registers buttons, preview downloads the complete raw book, explicit apply verifies server
apply without preview, ambiguous preview and target changes cannot write
chat and primary switches before apply or during reads stop all writes
unrelated edits after preview survive and newly ambiguous target comments reject
HTTP failures and saves that never persist are not reported as successful
artifact is a compilable helper component with two visible explicit buttons and no auto task
generated artifact executes its real serialized functions without hidden build dependencies

limits: Host APIs are doubled offline; real iframe buttons/download/import remain unverified.
The raw save API has no server-side CAS; avoid concurrent worldbook editing during the write.
A/B behavior is tested with a representative private-content fixture, not a new live export.
